description: Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.

a.request: For each invoice number in the invoice line items, compute the average `product_quantity` and the average over its lines of (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that cost ratio, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages.
a.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT `invoice_number`, AVG(CAST(`product_quantity` AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_qty, AVG(CASE WHEN `derived_total_cost` IS NOT NULL AND `derived_total_cost` != 0 THEN (`derived_product_cost` - `derived_total_cost`) / `derived_total_cost` ELSE NULL END) as avg_cost_ratio FROM `Invoice_Line_Items` GROUP BY `invoice_number`), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) as overall_avg_qty FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.`invoice_number`, i.avg_qty, i.avg_cost_ratio, (i.avg_qty - o.overall_avg_qty) as qty_difference FROM invoice_stats i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE i.avg_qty > o.overall_avg_qty ORDER BY qty_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

b.request: For each invoice, calculate the average product_quantity and the mean of the per-line-item ratios [(derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost], filter to invoices where average quantity exceeds the overall mean of all invoices' average quantities, display invoice number, average quantity, mean of ratios, and quantity difference from overall average, sorted descending by quantity difference, top 10 only.
b.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) as mean_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.mean_ratio, (i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_qty) as quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats i CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_qty ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: For each invoice, calculate the average product_quantity and the mean of the per-line-item ratios [(derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost], filter to invoices where average quantity exceeds the overall mean of all invoices' average quantities, display invoice number, average quantity, mean of ratios, and quantity difference from overall average, sorted descending by quantity difference, top 10 only.

d.request: For each invoice, calculate the average product_quantity across its line items and the mean of the per-line-item cost gap ratios ((derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost), filter to invoices with average quantity above the overall average quantity, and display invoice number, average quantity, mean cost gap ratio, and quantity difference from overall average, sorted descending by quantity difference, top 10.
d.sql:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS mean_cost_gap_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS overall_avg_qty
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT 
  invoice_stats.invoice_number,
  invoice_stats.avg_quantity,
  invoice_stats.mean_cost_gap_ratio,
  (invoice_stats.avg_quantity - overall_avg.overall_avg_qty) AS qty_difference
FROM invoice_stats
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
WHERE invoice_stats.avg_quantity > overall_avg.overall_avg_qty
ORDER BY qty_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

c.request: For each invoice in the invoice line items, find its average `product_quantity` and its relative gap between product cost and total cost, i.e. (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that relative gap, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages. Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.
c.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty FROM invoice_stats WHERE avg_quantity IS NOT NULL) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.avg_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_qty as qty_above_average FROM invoice_stats i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_qty ORDER BY qty_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
